title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Two homes, one player
hook: One player, two households. Who gets your messages?
intro: Dad shows up not knowing the schedule changed.
statement: Every adult in a child's life needs the same information.
q1: Do you ask families for every contact at the start —
q2: or let families share the information themselves?
q3: Who is missing from your list?
t1: Both can work. But kids show up ready
t2: when every adult gets the same message.
cta: Coaches — how do you handle it?
ctaLines: Collect all contacts. A team app. Ask the family.
ctaPrompt: Share your communication habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
One player, two households. Who gets your messages?
Mom gets the email. Dad shows up not knowing the schedule changed.
Every adult in a child's life needs the same information.
Collect every contact or let families share. Both can work.
How do you handle it? Share your habit in the comments.
